headline: Guard Note for rich/syntax.py Modifications
what_breaks: rich/segment.py — relies on Segment and Segments classes
rich/console.py — depends on Console and related types
rich/markdown.py — uses styles defined in this file
why: This file contains critical style definitions and segment handling that are directly used by multiple components. Changes here can affect the rendering and behavior of syntax highlighting across the Rich library.
checklist: Review changes to ANSI_LIGHT and ANSI_DARK styles
Check for impacts on Segment and Segments classes in rich/segment.py
Ensure compatibility with Console and ConsoleOptions in rich/console.py
